title: Classic Leather Jacket
description: Handcrafted from buttery-soft full-grain lambskin, this timeless biker jacket features asymmetric zip hardware, structured shoulders, and an interior silk-blend lining.
descriptionHtml:
A cornerstone of effortless rebellion and refined luxury. The Classic Leather Jacket is meticulously cut from supple, full-grain lambskin leather that develops a rich patina over time.

  • 100% genuine lambskin leather exterior
  • Smooth 60% silk, 40% cupro lining
  • Heavyweight polished nickel hardware with custom LUXE pullers
  • Asymmetric front zipper, zipped cuffs, and snap-down lapels
  • Specialist leather clean only

title: Heritage Trench Coat
description: Double-breasted cotton gabardine trench coat engineered with storm flaps, horn buttons, a removable D-ring waist belt, and signature micro-check lining.
descriptionHtml:
A masterclass in British tailoring and all-weather utility. The Heritage Trench Coat features a water-repellent dense cotton weave that shields against drizzle while remaining breathable.

  • 100% bespoke water-resistant cotton gabardine
  • Double-breasted silhouette with storm shield and gun flap
  • Genuine buffalo horn buttons and brass hardware
  • Adjustable belted cuffs and detachable waist tie
  • Dry clean only

title: Denim Trucker Jacket
description: Constructed from 13.5 oz Japanese selvage denim, with copper shank buttons, dual chest flap pockets, and an authentic vintage stone wash.
descriptionHtml:
A timeless wardrobe staple redefined with artisanal Japanese selvedge denim. Boxy, relaxed fit designed for versatile trans-seasonal layering.

  • 100% Japanese selvedge cotton denim (13.5 oz)
  • Custom antiqued copper hardware
  • Hand-distressed vintage rinse
  • Machine wash cold inside out

title: Wool Blend Overcoat
description: Tailored single-breasted coat woven in an Italian virgin wool-cashmere blend. Features notched lapels, deep welt pockets, and a clean structured drape.
descriptionHtml:
Sartorial elegance designed to combat freezing temperatures without sacrificing silhouette. Cut long for effortless proportion.

  • 80% Virgin Wool, 15% Cashmere, 5% Polyamide
  • Single back vent for unrestricted movement
  • Fully lined in viscose satin
  • Interior chest ticket pocket
  • Dry clean only

title: Quilted Puffer Vest
description: Ultra-lightweight yet warm down vest featuring a matte ripstop nylon shell, stand collar, two-way zipper, and concealed fleece-lined pockets.
descriptionHtml:
Essential transitional warmth. Filled with 700-fill power responsibly sourced goose down to insulate your core without excessive bulk.

  • Water-repellent recycled ripstop nylon
  • 700-fill RDS-certified white goose down insulation
  • Two-way YKK front zipper with storm flap
  • Interior zippered phone pocket
  • Machine washable on gentle

title: Relaxed Linen Shirt
description: Crafted from breathable 100% Normandy flax linen. Features mother-of-pearl buttons, a spread collar, and a breezy relaxed silhouette suited for resort or city wear.
descriptionHtml:
Effortlessly airy. Garment-washed for broken-in softness from day one, offering an unstructured drape that breathes under warm sunlight.

  • 100% French Normandy Linen
  • Real genuine mother-of-pearl buttons
  • Curved hem designed to be worn untucked or tucked
  • Pre-shrunk fabric
  • Machine wash delicate, hang dry

title: Silk Button-Up Blouse
description: Luxurious 19mm mulberry silk blouse designed with french seams, concealed placket, and subtle pleated back yoke for fluid movement.
descriptionHtml:
A refined staple for boardroom power dressing or dinner cocktail styling. Pure heavyweight mulberry silk that feels cool against the skin.

  • 100% Grade 6A Mulberry Silk (19 momme)
  • Concealed front button placket
  • French cuff detailing with shell button enclosures
  • Dry clean recommended

title: Cashmere Crewneck Sweater
description: Spun from 100% Grade-A Mongolian cashmere. Incredibly lightweight yet insulating, finished with fine-ribbed trims and tubular neckline.
descriptionHtml:
The ultimate everyday indulgence. Woven in 12-gauge knit using sustainably harvested Mongolian fleece for cloud-like softness.

  • 100% Mongolian Cashmere (Grade-A long staple fibers)
  • Pilling-resistant dense 2-ply construction
  • Ribbed cuffs, hem, and collar
  • Hand wash cold, dry flat

title: Vintage Graphic Tee
description: Heavyweight 240 GSM combed organic cotton t-shirt with screen-printed heritage typography, vintage enzyme wash, and reinforced drop shoulders.
descriptionHtml:
A casual cult favorite. Structured yet broken-in comfort, designed with an archival typography print commemorating the LUXE design atelier.

  • 100% GOTS certified organic combed cotton (240 GSM)
  • Distressed ribbed collar and cuffs
  • Soft eco-friendly water-based screen print
  • Machine wash cold inside out

title: Pleated Midi Dress
description: Architectural accordion sunburst pleats radiate from an empire waist. Features a keyhole back opening, flutter sleeves, and fluid movement.
descriptionHtml:
Dramatic movement meets graceful poise. Engineered with precision knife pleats that retain their crisp shape through every evening affair.

  • 100% Recycled Poly Georgette with subtle shimmer
  • Full tonal lining to knee
  • High mock neck with pearl button nape closure
  • Dry clean only

title: Evening Slip Dress
description: 90s-inspired bias-cut slip dress crafted from liquid satin silk. Features dainty adjustable spaghetti straps, a gentle cowl neckline, and side slit.
descriptionHtml:
Sensual minimalism at its finest. Cut on the bias to hug the body’s natural contours with a graceful drape that ripples as you walk.

  • 100% Heavyweight Mulberry Silk Satin
  • Draped cowl neckline with delicate rouleau straps
  • Mid-thigh side slit for walking ease
  • Hand wash cold or dry clean

title: Floral Summer Wrap Dress
description: Romantic self-tie wrap dress with hand-painted watercolor botanical motifs, ruffled high-low hemline, and breathable organic cotton voile fabric.
descriptionHtml:
Sun-drenched romance in every detail. Features an adjustable wrap waist that flatters every silhouette, finished with whimsical cascading ruffles.

  • 100% Organic Cotton Voile
  • Custom hand-painted French watercolor floral print
  • Self-tie sash belt and inner security button
  • Machine wash cold, air dry

title: Tailored Wide-Leg Trousers
description: High-waisted trousers with structured front pleats, pressed creases, side slash pockets, and an elongating floor-grazing wide leg.
descriptionHtml:
A high-impact foundation for modern tailoring. Crafted from crease-resistant wool blend crepe that drapes with statuesque grace.

  • 68% Virgin Wool, 30% Lyocell, 2% Elastane
  • Clean tailored waistband with concealed zip and hook closure
  • Deep functional front slash pockets
  • Dry clean

title: High-Rise Slim Jeans
description: Flattering high-rise slim denim woven with comfort-stretch Candiani denim. Features classic 5-pocket styling and antique silver rivet hardware.
descriptionHtml:
Sculpting comfort meets authentic denim character. Woven in Italy by the sustainable Candiani mill with premium stretch recovery.

  • 98% Cotton, 2% Elastane
  • 11.5-inch high rise with 28-inch inseam
  • Reinforced bartacks on stress points
  • Machine wash warm

title: Pleated Linen Shorts
description: Breezy tailored shorts crafted from washed pure linen. Features double front pleats, elasticized back waist for comfort, and a relaxed 5-inch inseam.
descriptionHtml:
A sunny weather essential that blends relaxed ease with sartorial polish. Double pleating creates clean lines while the breathable weave keeps you cool.

  • 100% Belgian Flax Linen
  • Elasticated back waistband with belt loops
  • Deep slash pockets and rear welt pockets
  • Gentle machine wash

title: Leather Crossbody Bag
description: Compact structured saddle bag crafted from Italian vegetable-tanned calfskin. Features custom magnetic gold-toned clasp and adjustable guitar strap.
descriptionHtml:
Sculpted to accompany you from morning cafe meetings to midnight dining. Finished with hand-painted beveled edges and lush suede interior lining.

  • 100% Italian vegetable-tanned calfskin leather
  • Brushed 18k gold-finish solid brass hardware
  • Interior zipper compartment and card slots
  • Adjustable shoulder strap (48cm - 58cm drop)
  • Protective dust bag included

title: Silk Printed Scarf
description: 90x90cm square scarf hand-screened onto rich silk twill. Features hand-rolled borders and an intricate equestrian-meets-geometric motif.
descriptionHtml:
A timeless statement of Parisian chic. Tie around your neck, wear as a bandeau top, or knot onto the handle of your favorite leather bag.

  • 100% Mulberry Silk Twill (16 momme)
  • Hand-rolled and hand-stitched hem edges
  • 90 cm x 90 cm square silhouette
  • Dry clean only

title: Classic Leather Belt
description: Hand-buffed full-grain bridle leather belt anchored by a minimalist solid brass buckle with subtle etched logo branding.
descriptionHtml:
Engineered for years of daily refinement. Vegetable tanned English bridle leather that grows softer and richer with every wear.

  • 100% Full-grain bridle cowhide leather (32mm width)
  • Solid brass buckle with satin antique finish
  • 7 adjustment holes with beveled edges
  • Made in Spain

title: Chelsea Leather Boots
description: Goodyear-welted Chelsea boots crafted from smooth French calf leather with ribbed elastic side gussets, woven pull tabs, and durable Vibram rubber soles.
descriptionHtml:
Iconic footwear built with traditional English Goodyear welt construction. Weather-resilient, resoleable, and supremely comfortable straight from the box.

  • Full-grain French calfskin upper
  • Breathable calf leather lining and cushioned insole
  • Storm-welted lightweight Vibram lug sole
  • Elasticated side gores with double pull tabs

title: Minimalist Canvas Sneakers
description: Low-profile sneakers handcrafted from heavyweight organic cotton canvas with vulcanized natural rubber soles and antimicrobial cork footbeds.
descriptionHtml:
Unassuming luxury for daily miles. Clean monochrome lines and eco-friendly vulcanized construction that pairs seamlessly with suits or casual denim.

  • Heavyweight 14oz organic cotton canvas upper
  • Ergonomic cushioned cork insole
  • Natural vulcanized rubber cupsole with herringbone traction
  • Tonal 100% waxed cotton laces
